note: Fixed 2026-10-21 BEFORE any alt order book was collected or looked at. Same estimator and every v2 threshold as cost_public_estimate_v2.json, applied to the 15 symbols of the forward-window basket (ADR 0023 draft). Two differences, both because alts are far thinner than BTC/ETH: (1) impact is fitted at 10,000 USDT (the order size every evaluation uses) instead of 100,000, since a 100,000 USDT walk would run out of visible depth on most alts and make the estimate unusable; (2) notionals are 1,000/10,000/50,000. The engine takes the WORSE symbol's parameters (existing behaviour), so the result is conservative for the basket. Not looser: nothing is relaxed except the fit size, and a notional whose book walk runs out of depth in >1% of snapshots is still excluded as a whole. Estimates stay ESTIMATED_FROM_PUBLIC_DATA, never VERIFIED.
